description: Clean technology supply chains can reproduce extractive harm without material justice.
Fossil-dependent workers and regions face serious harm without funded transition planning.
Clean generation can become stranded when interconnection transmission and flexibility lag.
Heavy industry may delay investment without public procurement infrastructure and standards.
Low-income households and renters may be excluded from electrification benefits.
Grid expansion can stall without participation benefit sharing and credible planning.
High-renewable systems need storage demand flexibility and market rules that reward reliability.
EV adoption can outpace charging access and local grid readiness.
